title: Anthropic may market IPO week of Nov 9, targets $1.8-$2T
key_facts: Bloomberg reported, citing sources familiar with the matter, that Anthropic wants to go public as early as mid-November, before Thanksgiving.
The roadshow (the investor sales tour) is to start on 9 November.
The sources said Anthropic still expects to complete its listing by the end of this year at the latest; it had earlier planned to file formally after the summer.
Anthropic is also expected to meet potential investors at its San Francisco headquarters on 14 October to prepare.
Recent AI safety concerns have not yet dampened investor enthusiasm, the report says; some put Anthropic's fair value between $1.8 trillion and $2 trillion.
quote_evidence: Anthropic is seeking to go public as early as mid-November, before Thanksgiving, and to kick off its initial public offering roadshow on November 9, Bloomberg reported, citing sources familiar with the matter.

The report said recent safety concerns regarding artificial intelligence have not yet dampened potential investors’ enthusiasm, with some pegging Anthropic’s fair valuation at between US$1.8 trillion (HK$14 billion) and US$2 trillion.
why_it_matters_hint: A single anonymous-source report gives firm dates for what would be one of the largest stock listings ever.
event_date: Bloomberg report; the Standard article undated in the fetched text (carried 5 Oct 2026)
notes: NewsBytes page was blocked (HTTP 403); The Standard used instead. The Thanksgiving target repeats Bloomberg 1 Oct report carried in our 4 Oct edition; it is not clear whether the Standard relays that same report or a newer one.
